ValidationRule.description: This validation rule is needed to restrict the user if the case is KYC QA Case and Status is not Pending Documents.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Customer_Nudge', ISPICKVAL(Type,'TASK_TYPE_ID_UPLOAD'), Case__r.RecordType.DeveloperName ='KYC_QA', ISNEW(), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Case__r.Status,'Pending Documents')) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please ensure the Case Status is Pending Documents for creating Id Upload task.
